We have mass spec: m/z 224.1201 (M+? likely molecular ion). So molecular weight ~224.12. Carbon NMR shows many aromatic carbons: many peaks around 128-129, plus 196.8 (likely carbonyl C=O), 143,139,135,127, plus aliphatic: 37.5, 36.39, 26.41. So likely a ketone attached to aromatic rings and an alkyl chain.

We validated a SMILES: c1ccccc1C(=O)CC(C)c2ccccc2 . Let's compute formula and mass. Use get_formula.
